notes: Top-line: large EU legal documents company evaluating RAG-based enterprise search. POC started 2026-01-15. Primary asks: high per-language recall for 12 EU languages, <150ms tail latency for reranking endpoint, sub-$0.02 average cost/query for 50k qps baseline. Sensitive data: client contracts, court filings -> strong residency and retention controls required. SE asks: sample indexing pipeline, vector dimensionality trade-offs, rerank model pipeline (dense+cross-encoder), and how Redwood handles per-language embeddings + fallback model routing. AE summary: "Need reliable per-language metrics before committing to Dedicated. If Redwood can show per-language recall improvements and cost modelling, procurement will move fast."

indexing_requirements: Target corpus: ~120M documents (legal dockets, contracts, memos). Language split: EN 48%, FR 12%, DE 10%, ES 8%, IT 6%, PL 4%, NL 3%, EL 2%, SV/DA/NO/CS combined 7%. Need per-language embeddings quality checks and per-language rerank calibrations.
latency_targets: Rerank tail (p99) <= 150ms for single-shot queries; recall-aware pipeline allows async rerank for heavy queries. Embeddings upsert throughput target: 200k docs/day with burst to 1M/day.
cost_sensitivity: Moderate-high. Procurement target is total cost of ownership that keeps average query cost under $0.02 at expected load (50k qps combined across routes). Open to Dedicated pricing if unit economics beat hosted at scale.
model_preferences: Prefer open-model embeddings tuned per language. Interested in Redwood-verified multilingual encoders and a lightweight cross-encoder for final rerank (can be hosted or on Dedicated). Want fallback routing to smaller, cheaper models for low-cost tiers.
evaluation_metrics: Per-language recall@10, MRR, per-language precision, latency p50/p95/p99, cost/query modeled at 3 load profiles (dev, steady, peak). Also track token-level cost for summarization routes.
poc_scope: 1) Index 10M documents (sample) across 6 priority languages and measure recall/precision. 2) Implement dense retrieval + cross-encoder rerank for highest-traffic routes. 3) Validate VPC networking and KMS integration for in-flight and at-rest encryption.
poc_timeline: Baseline POC (6 weeks): week1 ingestion and mapping; week2 embedding quality checks; week3 rerank prototype; week4 latency tuning; week5 security review; week6 cost modeling and exec presentation.
success_criteria: Per-language recall@10 improvement >= 15% over current Elastic baseline for priority languages; p99 rerank latency <= 150ms for 95% of test queries; cost per query at or below forecast target for steady-state.
commercial_notes: Procurement wants a 12-month committed Dedicated option if Redwood proves per-language SLAs. Budget range indicated $250k-$750k ARR. Requires enterprise contract addendum for EU data residency.
cs_notes: If move to Dedicated: plan onboarding workshop with Solutions Eng + Optimize to tune batching/quantization. Request CSM-led quarterly health check focusing on per-language regressions.
open_questions: 1) Can Redwood provide per-language embedding models validated on legal corpora? 2) How deterministic are rerank outputs after quantization? 3) Latency guarantees for cross-region fallback?
recent_feedback: BridgeCrest: "Demo showed strong EN results but PL/EL need work. If you can show consistent improvements for small languages we move to procurement."
assumptions: Will provide 10M sample docs for POC; will accept hashed/anonymized files for security review; can provide compute for on-prem staging if needed.
risks: Per-language model degradation after quantization, underestimated network egress for cross-region fallback, procurement legal delay around residency clause.
